title: Ferroni 2026 · Experiment 4 · Body posture
citation: Ferroni, F., Rastelli, F., Langiulli, N., Rinaldi, L. S., Gallese, V., & Ardizzi, M. (2026). Dealing with the world close to our body. Characterizing determinants of peripersonal space plasticity. Neuropsychologia, 229, 109490.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.analysis: Estimate between-distance PPS location (PSE) and steepness (DL) using Spearman–Kärber on participant-level 10% trimmed reaction time means. Compare session and assigned group with a participant random intercept.

seated_assessment.cue: A virtual 6.5 cm red sphere approaches in HTC Vive Pro video passthrough, rendered with Unity 2019.4.34 at 75 cm/s.
seated_assessment.response: Left-hand controller button after a 10 ms right-controller vibration.

published_method.other_postures: Lying on a cot or standing changes the sphere path to a diagonal, with an approximately 120 cm origin height. Seated sphere distances do not establish the other posture paths.
published_method.training: Seated: 50 cubes with two right-hand gripper transfers per cube. Lying or standing: 25 cubes with four transfers each. All groups make 100 movements.
published_method.analysis_example: The publisher's standing analysis example indexes 15 looming RT rows per level and supplies the timing vector in descending order. Realized allocations and column-to-onset mapping require original records.

stimulus_type.source: Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher Fig. 4, experimental setup; Ferroni et al. 2026, mmc1.docx, PPS control analyses, §2.4

source_provenance.value: Neuropsychologia 229 (2026), article 109490, publisher version of record

trajectory_count.source: Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher version of record, §§2–3 (pp. 2–7), Figs. 1–4
trajectory_count.gap: Approach geometry varies by group. Audio assessments also include a stationary control.

trajectory_path.value: Hand shown in PPS and training figures. Visuo-tactile red sphere, headset and handheld controllers. The target display and tool arrangement follow each posture.
trajectory_path.source: Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher Fig. 4, experimental setup; Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher Fig. 5, tactile-onset axis and RT traces
trajectory_path.gap: Absolute geometry and trajectory profile unverified.

condition_intermixing.gap: Within-session stimulus intermixing and randomization algorithm are unreported.

iti_jitter_policy.source: Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher version of record, §2 (p. 2)

response_window.source: Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher version of record, §2 (p. 2)

task_sequence_rules.value: Pre-training PPS assessment, motor tool training, post-training PPS assessment. Approximately 10 minutes per session. The tool is absent from the two assessment sessions.
task_sequence_rules.source: Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher version of record, §2 (p. 2)

soa_table.gap: Five reported nominal onsets agree with Fig. 5. The standing estimator vector is reversed, and lying/standing distance-at-touch coordinates are not reported separately.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: Standing script indexes 15 rows per distance after missing-row removal. The separate scalar 12 is a pooling weight. Realized trial counts and the count for other cohorts are unverified.

total_trial_count.source: Ferroni et al. 2026, publisher version of record, §2.4.2 (pp. 5–6); mmc3.zip standing example

implementation_gaps: Exact trial counts, block sizes, intertrial timing and response windows per assessment group are unreported.
Validate both assessments and the intervening physical training with the corresponding cohort and original geometry. Original realized trial sequences and participant analysis inputs are unavailable.
Recover posture-specific path coordinates and verify delivered VR and haptic timing in each posture. Reconcile the descending analysis vector with observed trial labels.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
